full_judgment:
Afzal Hossain Ahmed J: This Appeal, at the instance of the plaintiff, is directed against the judgment and decree dated 29-9-1999 passed by the learned. Subordinate Judge, First Court, Khulna in Title Suit No. 10 of 1998 dismissing the suit for Specific Performance of Contract. 

 6. During trial plaintiff examined as many as 4 witnesses and also adduced a series of documentary evidence in support of her case and, on the contrary, the defendant No. 3 Government of Bangladesh neither examined any witness nor adduced any documentary evidence in support of its contention. The learned Subordinate Judge having heard both the parties and considered the evidence adduced by the plaintiff dismissed the suit against the defendants by the judgment and decree dated 29-9-1999 against which the plaintiff has preferred this appeal. 

 9. The issue for consideration in this appeal is, whether the learned Subordinate Judge was justified in passing the impugned judgment and decree dismissing the suit. 

 15. In the result, this appeal is allowed and the impugned judgment and decree is set aside and the suit is decreed against the defendants.
